title: New Year, New Lightning Talks
summary: The inaugural Learning Futures Brighton meetup, featuring three lightning talks.

speaker1.name: Mark Aberdour & Tosin Adebisi
speaker1.talkTitle: Launching a Youth Leadership Social Enterprise
speaker1.description: Lessons from developing and piloting the ARLLS youth leadership programme.

speaker2.name: Sally Burns
speaker2.talkTitle: Filling the gap in the creator economy
speaker2.description: The journey from identifying a market gap to launching The Portal.

speaker3.name: Stuart Lamour
speaker3.talkTitle: Swimming upstream against a great torrent of disorganisation
speaker3.description: Lightweight UX research to improve LMS navigation, clarity and learner experience.
